display.purpose: Empty-state greetings and rare top-level statements.

body.purpose: Conversation content and explanatory product copy.

shadows.name: composer-lift
shadows.purpose: Soft separation for the anchored chat composer.

shadows.name: dialog-lift
shadows.purpose: Diffuse depth for modal surfaces only.

motion.name: interface-state
motion.purpose: Default hover, focus, and compact interaction transition.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-contrast creation action used once per sidebar header.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--foreground, #111312); color: var(--background, #fbfbfa); font: 600 13px/1.5 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground, #111312) 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.99); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #4f8463) 35%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Accent Icon Button
components.description: Compact positive action used for send controls.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-accent" aria-label="Send message"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 19V5m0 0-5 5m5-5 5 5"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-grid; width: 44px; height: 44px; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--primary, #4f8463); color: #fff; transition: background-color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-accent svg { width: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #4f8463) 90%, #111312); } .ds-btn-accent:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #4f8463) 35%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Bordered search field used in the sidebar header.
components.css: .ds-input-search { width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--input, #dedfdd); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--foreground, #111312); font: 400 14px/1.5 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input-search::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, #656a66); } .ds-input-search:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground, #111312) 24%, var(--input, #dedfdd)); } .ds-input-search:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring, #4f8463); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #4f8463) 20%, transparent); outline: 0; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: Sentence-case navigation row with an outline icon and tonal active state.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; width: 100%; height: 36px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--sidebar-foreground, #171918); font: 400 14px/1.5 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; text-align: left; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item-active { background: var(--sidebar-accent, #e8ece8); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--sidebar-ring, #4f8463) 30%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Bordered Card
components.description: Flat content container separated by a hairline border.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #dedfdd); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--card-foreground, #111312); font: 400 14px/1.5 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-card strong { display: block; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--muted-foreground, #656a66); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground, #111312) 20%, var(--border, #dedfdd)); } .ds-card:focus-within { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #4f8463) 20%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chat Composer
components.description: Wide anchored input surface with quiet ambient lift.
components.css: .ds-composer { display: grid; min-height: 116px; padding: 18px 18px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #dedfdd); border-radius: 24px; background: var(--card, #fff); box-shadow: 0 14px 34px -28px rgba(17,19,18,.34); } .ds-composer textarea { min-height: 52px; resize: none; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, #111312); font: 400 16px/1.5 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-composer button { justify-self: end; width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--primary, #4f8463); color: #fff; font-size: 20px; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-composer button:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #4f8463) 90%, #111312); } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color: var(--ring, #4f8463); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #4f8463) 15%, transparent), 0 14px 34px -28px rgba(17,19,18,.34); }

narrative.overview: Dev3 is a clear, composed workspace that recedes until the user needs it. Warm near-white planes, soft dividers, restrained green signals, and one sans-serif family keep attention on the conversation and the work around it.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral surfaces with a sparse sage accent.
Inter Variable across display, body, and interface roles.
An 8px spacing rhythm with compact 4px refinements.
Flat surfaces separated by tone and hairline borders.

rules.name: The Sparse Signal Rule
rules.body: Sage marks action or state; it does not become a decorative field.

rules.name: The Warm Canvas Rule
rules.body: Major workspace surfaces stay warm-neutral rather than cool gray or stark blue-white.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Use Inter Variable for product UI and display roles; create contrast through scale, weight, and tracking.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Navigation and section labels use natural sentence case, not tracked all-caps kickers.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces use borders or tonal contrast; shadow is reserved for anchored inputs and modal depth.

dos: Do preserve generous whitespace around the empty-state greeting and composer.
Do use Lucide-style outline icons at consistent size and stroke weight.
Do communicate structure with borders, tone, and spacing before adding shadow.
Do keep the sidebar useful and information-rich while the main stage remains quiet.
donts: Don't add starter-card grids to the chat empty state.
Don't use sage as a broad decorative background or apply gradients to text.
Don't mix filled, multicolor, and outline icon families in the same control group.
Don't introduce tracked uppercase kickers or ornamental labels into product navigation.
